decisions.reason: Connector placement and orientation do not change the active three-board architecture.
The source changes the battery JST's physical placement and orientation, not the connector interface's required NTC contact.
Battery JST placement and orientation do not alter the specified electrical or thermal protection behavior.
The mechanical connector arrangement does not change the TVS ESD protection requirement.
The connector layout decision does not affect charge-status indication through the main-board SK6812 LED chain.
Battery and board JST placement does not change I2C cable length, speed, pull-up resistance, or pull-up location.
The physical JST arrangement does not alter ESP32 clock, sleep, or wake behavior.
The connector placement and orientation decision does not change the software-switched 5V rail's control or operating behavior.
